title: Handling & Resolving Merge Conflicts
introduction: Every developer dreads merge conflicts until they understand what actually causes them. Today you demystify merge conflicts: why Git pauses when two people edit the same lines, how to read conflict markers (`<<<<<<<`, `=======`, `>>>>>>>`), and how to resolve them calmly in VS Code or any text editor.
why_it_matters: Merge conflicts are not bugs or disasters — they are Git safely asking *you* to make the final human decision rather than guessing and accidentally destroying somebody's work. Once you master this skill, you will never panic during a team hackathon again.
practical_activity_preview: Intentionally create a merge conflict between two branches, resolve it, and complete the merge.
